# MisorderedModifiers

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `MisorderedModifiersInspection`

PSR-1/PSR-12 style expects method modifiers in a fixed order: `final` /
`abstract` first, then the visibility, then `static`. Methods whose modifiers
are written in another order are flagged and re-sorted.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,18,19,20,21,22} [Before]
<?php

interface Registry
{
    static public function instance();
    public static function reset();
}

abstract class Repository
{
    public static function boot() {}
    abstract protected function table();
    final static function hash() {}
    protected
        static function cache() {}
    PRIVATE STATIC function lower() {}

    protected abstract function columns();
    static
        protected final function guard() {}
    Static Private Final function seal() {}
    public static abstract function make();
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

interface Registry
{
    public static function instance();
    public static function reset();
}

abstract class Repository
{
    public static function boot() {}
    abstract protected function table();
    final static function hash() {}
    protected
        static function cache() {}
    PRIVATE STATIC function lower() {}

    abstract protected function columns();
    final protected static function guard() {}
    final private static function seal() {}
    abstract public static function make();
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Reorder modifiers as: public static.</li>
<li>line 18: Reorder modifiers as: abstract protected.</li>
<li>line 19: Reorder modifiers as: final protected static.</li>
<li>line 21: Reorder modifiers as: final private static.</li>
<li>line 22: Reorder modifiers as: abstract public static.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MisorderedModifiers": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MisorderedModifiers

/**
 * @noinspection MisorderedModifiersInspection
 */
```
